purpose: Test a two-context, causal-surprise routed confirmed action-consequence memory on A->B->A recurrence rather than continuous forgetting or a neural residual. Author-synthetic DEV falsification only.
hypothesis: Preserving an earlier causal model while learning an alternative and non-oracle selecting it will improve both mid-episode switched-regime prediction and post-return recovery without degrading stable worlds relative to strong FIT-selected W256, within a CPU budget.

families.B: independently-seeded anisotropic actions with coordinate integer division by 2**(j%4)

phases.rule: B for half of worlds, otherwise A

source.probes: 3 fresh withheld actions per world, never written as factual events
source.causal_rule: P86 integer/dyadic rank4 basis u0,v0 and u1,v1; no oracle labels passed to predictor

model.learned_state: 2x16x16 float32 W plus 2 float32 innovation EWMAs = 514 float32 persistent values/world; active context and counts are int control state and must be disclosed
model.training: confirmed-only online updates using normalized actions; no offline neural weights
model.route: recurrent causal-surprise gate compares active-vs-inactive predictive errors; spawn alternate context only after sufficient active-history and sequential surprise, return to previously learned context only when consistently lower observed prediction error; threshold/tolerance selected on FIT only from fixed 2x2 grid

controls: FIT-selected 9-point conventional W256 eta∈{0.5,1.0,1.5}, decay∈{0.95,0.99,1.0}; evaluated on untouched CAL
514-float capacity-matched W256 with 258 inert floats, output bitwise identical to selected W256

reproducibility.selection: deterministic FIT-only grid; CAL scores once; never change thresholds after CAL

qualification.G4: full Windows+Ubuntu test suite at exact candidate SHA
qualification.G5: native TTT Windows+Ubuntu at exact candidate SHA
qualification.G7: pinned Mamba2 Ubuntu at exact candidate SHA
qualification.scientific: independent external preapproved source and robust multi-seed qualification NOT included
